description: This file defines an abstract PHPUnit test case class 'KernelTestCase' in the OrangeHRM project, providing utility methods for setting up application kernel and services, including mock service setup, container management, and HTTP request simulation.

classes.name: KernelTestCase
classes.description: An abstract base test class providing setup for kernel and services, facilitating HTTP request simulation and dependency injection for testing purposes.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Clears the entity manager and creates a fresh kernel for each test.

methods.name: getHttpRequest
methods.description: Constructs and returns a new Request object with specified parameters, to simulate HTTP requests.

methods.name: createKernel
methods.description: Initializes and returns a mock Framework kernel, resetting container services before setup.

methods.name: createKernelWithMockServices
methods.description: Creates a kernel and injects additional mock services for testing.

methods.name: updateOptions
methods.description: Updates the options array controlling helper and base service inclusion.

methods.name: setHelperServices
methods.description: Sets mock helper services (DateTime, I18N) into the container if configured to do so.

methods.name: setBaseServices
methods.description: Sets standard core services (project, performance, vacancy, candidate) into the container if configured to do so.
